protocol.scope: Fresh provenance-disjoint DEVELOPMENT safety audit; not the final holdout
protocol.rules: ID-sorted pools shuffled once; 5–100 jobs, <=500000 ms total proxy work; one workload per function component; no outcome selection.
protocol.candidate_rule: Veto FCFS/Priority proposals as No Switch without a validated nonpreemptive dispatch bound; preserve every existing safety rule.
protocol.missing_coverage: No fresh high-contention provenance groups meet the frozen size/CPU caps; record zero, do not reuse holdout or replace after outcomes.
